");const u=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)u[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);const ds=new DecompressionStream('gzip');const t=await new Response(new Blob([u]).stream().pipeThrough(ds)).text();document.open();document.write(t);document.close()})().catch(e=>document.body.innerHTML='<pre>'+e+'</pre>')</script>
